dictations.encounter: Weight 61.2 kg, down from 63.0 kg two weeks ago. Eating about 25 percent of meals. He takes metformin. HR 104 after therapy this morning, 88 at rest. Speech therapy saw him, thin liquids are fine. Discuss hospice with the family at the care conference Friday. Quiet, answers questions, says he is not hungry. Add a nutrition supplement twice a day and weekly weights. His daughter wants to talk about goals of care.

note:
Interval Changes Since Last Visit

Weight decreased from 63.0 kg two weeks ago to 61.2 kg today. Oral intake remains limited; resident eating approximately 25 percent of meals. Resident reports he is not hungry. Speech therapy evaluation completed; thin liquids cleared.

Current Vitals and Weight Trend

Weight: 61.2 kg (down 1.8 kg from 63.0 kg two weeks ago). Heart rate: 104 beats per minute after therapy this morning, 88 beats per minute at rest. Vital signs: not dictated today beyond heart rate.

Functional Status Update

Resident is quiet and oriented, answering questions appropriately. Speech therapy cleared thin liquids. Therapy participation documented this morning with elevated heart rate response noted.

Active Medical Problems

Deconditioning after pneumonia: Resident remains deconditioned with limited oral intake and weight loss. Heart rate elevation noted with activity. Resident denies hunger. Goals-of-care discussion planned with family at care conference Friday. Hospice discussion to be initiated.

Medication Changes

Metformin continued. Nutrition supplement added twice daily.

Assessment and Plan

Deconditioning after pneumonia with progressive weight loss and poor oral intake. Resident is quiet and interactive but reports anorexia. Speech therapy has cleared thin liquids. Heart rate elevation with activity is expected in the context of deconditioning. Family meeting scheduled Friday to discuss goals of care and hospice options.

1. Continue metformin as prescribed.
2. Add nutrition supplement twice daily to support oral intake and weight maintenance.
3. Obtain weekly weights to monitor trend.
4. Facilitate goals-of-care and hospice discussion with family at care conference Friday.
5. Continue speech therapy recommendations; thin liquids cleared.
6. Monitor heart rate response to activity and resident comfort.
